regions.today: Mostly cloudy with limited sunny spells, and showers spreading from the west, some heavy with isolated thunderstorms. Light to moderate southwest winds.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be cloudy with limited clear spells and continued showers, some heavy. Lowest temperatures of 10 to 12 degrees in a light southwesterly breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Cloudy tomorrow morning but dry for most with isolated showers. More widespread showers will spread from the west in the afternoon, with sunny spells developing also. Showers will clear in the evening. Highest temperatures of 16 to 19 degrees in light to moderate westerly winds.
